claims.text: The Assembly reports that when nominations closed at 4.30pm 'today', two nominations for Prime Minister had been received, the first on Monday 13 December and the second that day, and that the candidates would be revealed at the meeting to elect the Prime Minister Designate 'tomorrow, Wednesday 15 December at 10am'.
claims.uncertainty: Candidates are not named. In the Assembly's news sequence the next notice was created on 4 January 2022; no Assembly notice of the 15 December result was found.
